breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to use a k-point grid that is both half-shifted and gamma-centered. The ground truth resolves this conflict by removing the 'gamma-centered' requirement. The agent failed to resolve this and repeated the contradictory instruction: 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift and keep it gamma-centered.'
